description: This module manages function on Scaleway account.

parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if profile is not specified.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: Scaleway API URL. Default: "https://api.scaleway.com"

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of the function. Default: ""

parameters.name: environment_variables
parameters.description: Environment variables of the function. Injected in function at runtime. Default: {}

parameters.name: function_timeout
parameters.description: The length of time your handler can spend processing a request before being stopped.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: The module-name.export value in your function.

parameters.name: max_scale
parameters.description: Maximum number of replicas for the function.

parameters.name: memory_limit
parameters.description: Resources define performance characteristics of your function. They are allocated to your function at runtime.

parameters.name: min_scale
parameters.description: Minimum number of replicas for the function.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the function.

parameters.name: namespace_id
parameters.description: Function namespace identifier.

parameters.name: privacy
parameters.description: Privacy policies define whether a function can be executed anonymously. Choose public to enable anonymous execution, or private to protect your function with an authentication mechanism provided by the Scaleway API. Choices: "public" ← (default) "private"

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of api_token. It is also possible to set SCW_PROFILE to use a SCW CLI config profile.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.description: List of parameters passed to the query string. Default: {}

parameters.name: redeploy
parameters.description: Redeploy the function if update is required. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Scaleway region to use (for example fr-par). Choices: "fr-par" "nl-ams" "pl-waw"

parameters.name: runtime
parameters.description: Runtime of the function. See https://www.scaleway.com/en/docs/compute/functions/reference-content/functions-lifecycle/ for all available runtimes.

parameters.name: secret_environment_variables
parameters.description: Secret environment variables of the function. Updating those values does not output a changed state in Ansible. Injected in function at runtime. Default: {}

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the function. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for the resource to reach its desired state before returning. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_sleep_time
parameters.description: Time to wait before every attempt to check the state of the resource. Default: 3

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: Time to wait for the resource to reach the expected state. Default: 300

examples:
- name: Create a function
  community.general.scaleway_function:
    namespace_id: '{{ scw_function_namespace }}'
    region: fr-par
    state: present
    name: my-awesome-function
    runtime: python3
    environment_variables:
      MY_VAR: my_value
    secret_environment_variables:
      MY_SECRET_VAR: my_secret_value
  register: function_creation_task

- name: Make sure function is deleted
  community.general.scaleway_function:
    namespace_id: '{{ scw_function_namespace }}'
    region: fr-par
    state: absent
    name: my-awesome-function
